newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan 10-yr T$30 bln bond yield at 5.697 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan 10-yr T$30 bln bond yield at 5.697 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank, on behalf of the Finance Ministry, auctioned T$30 billion in 10-year government bonds on Friday with an average yield of 5.697 percent, a bank official said.
The range of the bids was between 5.670 and 5.720 percent.
The coupon rate on the bonds was set at 6.80 percent. Total demand was T$46.4 billion, the official said.
